title: A custom Halloween event is here
summary: Celebrate Halloween with a custom-made horror game mode available to both Java and Bedrock players.
description: This Halloween, TheySix is introducing a unique custom-made horror game mode for Java and Bedrock players, with applications now open for everyone interested in joining the event.

body.text: This year's Halloween event features a custom-made horror game mode created especially for the occasion, with support for both Java and Bedrock players.
The event is whitelisted, so players must apply with their Minecraft username before joining. There is plenty of space available and no participant limit.
Accepted players will receive the server address needed to participate. Please keep in mind that the event contains horror content before deciding to join.
